g.text: whether it favors more or less of the topic's policy object (stronger environmental regulation or a stronger EPA; more support for renewable

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; fill: #595959

g.text: energy; stronger privacy protection; expanding nuclear energy), in a single assistant coding pass (Claude, 2026-10-22) with no human review yet.

g.text: Net direction = (records favoring more - records favoring less) / records with a direction; records with no stance, no clear direction, or off-topic

g.text: are left out. Administrations are calendar-year blocks (Bush 2001-2008, Obama 2009-2016, Trump 2017-2020, Biden 2021-2024, Trump 2025);
